explanation: Merged main (#30, #31) into the CSV seam branch. From this branch: csv.test.ts pins the CSV seam (escaping table, formula guard, BOM/CRLF, provenance columns), csvDownload.ts is the shared reader for a mocked downloadFile, csvDialog.test.tsx covers the HypoMap dialog download, and the library, gene-list, gene and circadian export tests read files through that helper. From main: sourceJson.test.ts and baselineTeaser.test.ts cover the expression-source reader, and explorerSession.test.tsx pins the analysis snapshot defaults.
